Delhi CM Gupta Criticizes Opposition Protests Over SIR

Delhi Chief Minister Gupta has criticized opposition parties for causing inconvenience to the public through protests, stating that similar incidents ('SIR') have occurred previously. He questioned why objections were being raised now, implying a lack of substantive arguments from the opposition, and drawing parallels to past debates around EVM hacking.
